fields.statement: On the VM: `rhiza project ls` in ~/code lists nebari (initialised) and rhiza (initialised). `systemctl --user is-active rhiza-root.service` prints active; rhiza-rhiza.service could not be found (uninstalled). `rhiza health` exits 0 in ~/code/rhiza and shows the daemon running. ~/code/rhiza.toml now sets self_update_project = "rhiza" and holds the daemon settings (maxRuns, permissionMode, selfUpdate, web host); those keys were unset from the rhiza checkout's git config, and health still passes with them.
